card.line: Pergamum was a city in Asia Minor where one of the seven churches stood, and Jesus spoke to it, praising its faithfulness and warning it to repent.

moments.title: Jesus speaks to Pergamum
moments.text: Jesus, who holds the sharp double-edged sword, praises the church for holding fast to His name, even when Antipas was killed. He calls the whole church to repent, warns that He will wage war with the sword of His mouth against those who hold false teaching, and promises hidden manna and a white stone to the one who overcomes.
